name: Yan Wang
subtitle: Damned King of Diyu
description: Lockout your enemies abilities whilst stealing their divine powers
lore: Merciless judge of Diyu, Tian’s underworld, Yan Wang oversees the disposition of the dead. He views Ryven as an affront, for Destiny’s reordering removed some souls from his domain through resurrection, and prevented others from dying when they should have. He has petitioned the Celestial Bureaucracy to correct this wrongdoing, an endeavor that might see his influence spread far beyond Diyu.
divinity_generator: Gain [40] Divinity when placing a [Debuff] on an enemy.

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Ignore RES +20%, DMG Multiplier +30%, DMG Reduction Multiplier +20%
Awaken the ability: Judgement of Diyu
Attunement Multiplier +50%, Armor Multiplier +30%, Weapon Multiplier +30%

skills.name: Judgement of Diyu
skills.description: Increase this hero’s INIT by 2% (stacking up to 30%) after placing a [Debuff].
skills.awakening_bonus: For each [Debuff] on an enemy, reduce the damage they inflict by 5%, up to a maximum of 25%.

skills.name: Dreadful Omen
skills.description: Attack all enemies (280%ATK+250%INIT) with a 75% chance to place a random [mechanic:def-down-ii], [mechanic:atk-down-ii], [mechanic:acc-down-ii], or [mechanic:res-down-ii] on each target for 2 turns.
skills.awakening_bonus: If an enemy is already under [SPD Down II] has a 75% chance to place an additional [Debuff].

skills.name: Infernal Silence
skills.description: Attack all enemies (220%ATK+220%INIT), then has a 50% chance to place [mechanic:lock-core], and [mechanic:lock-ultimate] on each target for 2 turns.

skills.name: Spirit Shackles
skills.description: Attack all enemies (120%ATK+120%INIT) with a 35% chance to place [mechanic:spd-down-ii] on each target for 1 turn.
skills.awakening_bonus: If an enemy is already under [SPD Down II], has a 35% chance to place [Sleep] for 1 turn instead.

imprint_passive: Increase this hero’s INIT by 1% (stacking up to 15%) after placing a [Debuff].
